notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-D RND:5 inserts 5 randomly generated source IP addresses alongside the real source IP. Target sees scan appearing to originate from 6 hosts simultaneously — difficult to identify the real attacker.

=== CRITICAL CONSTRAINT ===
Decoy IPs must be live reachable hosts. If decoys are non-existent IPs, the target cannot complete handshakes with them — may trigger SYN-flood defenses. Use -D with known-live IPs or RND which generates random IPs (less reliable, may select dead IPs).

=== MECHANISM ===
Real IP is placed at a random position among decoys. Target logs show all decoy IPs equally, making attribution difficult. Does NOT encrypt traffic — only obscures source.

=== CHAINING ===
Combine with -sS for quiet scan from apparent multiple sources. Real IP still appears in logs — this is obfuscation, not anonymity.
